description: This file contains unit test cases for the LeavePeriodAPI class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It tests methods related to retrieving and listing leave period information, as well as validation rules, ensuring correct behavior and integration with services.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeavePeriodAPI, covering retrieval, listing, validation, and updating leave periods within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a specific leave period, verifying normal data and meta information.

methods.name: testGetOneLeavePeriodUndefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when no leave period is defined, expecting default values.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getOne API method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all leave periods and corresponding meta info.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a leave period with different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides data sets for parameterized tests of the update method.
